question: What benefit does a linga made from bilva and other leaves provide?
premises: A linga can be made from bilva and other leaves
This linga increases sons or progeny
inference: A leaf-born linga made from bilva and similar leaves promotes the increase of progeny.
uncertainties: yattatputra may be read as promoting sons specifically or progeny generally
plain_english: A linga made from bilva and other leaves increases progeny.
